_doc: Local alert rules evaluated by scripts/ops/alerts.gd every interval_s. A firing rule prints 'OPS_ALERT {json}', is appended to user://ops/alerts.jsonl when error tracking or analytics records to disk, and toasts in game only with flag ops_alerts and GRIDFALL_OPS_ALERTS_UI=1. Kinds: frame_time_p95_ms, gmi_breaker_open, gmi_live_failure_ratio, errors_per_minute, sim_tick_stall. {value} and {threshold} expand in message.

rules.message: Frame time p95 {value} ms is over {threshold} ms (below 20 fps).
GMI circuit breaker is open: live calls are paused and the city runs on cache and heuristics.
{value} of recent live GMI calls failed (threshold {threshold}).
{value} engine/script errors in the last minute.
The simulation has not advanced a tick for {value}x the expected tick time.
